positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Little Caesars (Optomi)/ Senior Software Engineer
- Optimized web and mobile performance for locations with latent online accessibility through throttling
- Adjusted LCE Fundraiser website to use lazy loading
- Increased web performance by over 20% and mobile performance by over 50%
- Helped establish new data processing format for web banners
- Used tree shaking to segregate packages to be preloaded
Ally Bank (Optomi)/ Senior Frontend Software Engineer
- Integrated Contentful (CMS) to Ally Mobile React Native app
- Developed Welcome feature in RN for transitioning from app’s first open to main Ally Bank App.
- Reworked Explore for Ally Bank App while recreating navigation and using deeplinks
- Updated ios/android to use Arkana for secret handling and bridged functions to React Native
- Maintained, updated and added graphql querie

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented Pixall (analytics) in conjunction to Adobe Analytics through
the use of eventbus systems
Developed new features and maintained the current system with React, NodeJS, AWS, New Relic and Splunk
Made immediate changes from incident reports / on call duty, lowering overall incidents
Full integration test through testcafe and e2e with Jest
Migrated services to newer lambda functions
Maintained and improved current services from internal to external

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and implement new tax policies into multiple applications with ReactJs and NodeJs
Teach entries through pair programming
Help UX and Project Manager with architectural decisions
Full integration test through cypress and e2e with Jest, implementing TDD development practices
Migrate legacy data from Ibmdb2 to Postgres and GCP
Set up pipelines through TeamCity and CloudFoundry
Began disbanding legacy applications
